hypothesis: Use one seed-invariant deterministic spherical token codebook for every independently prepared SeqFlow artifact, removing preparation-seed-specific token-center geometry so the learned representations share a common discrete neighborhood basis and can vary only through the inherited corpus and optimizer stochasticity.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive normalizing flow on corpus-only SELFIES so that each discrete molecule has a continuous token-latent encoding whose left-inverse reconstructs that same sequence. In each fresh objective session, encode the oracle-evaluated molecules, fit a task-local Gaussian-process surrogate to their latent codes and observed scores, and center local trust regions on high-scoring evaluated anchors. Generate a new ephemeral candidate pool each round by uniformly choosing latent-token blocks to perturb inside those regions, inverse-decode the perturbed points, and locally reject invalid, previously evaluated, or duplicate molecules before using posterior Thompson samples to choose the announced batch. Returned scores update the surrogate, anchors, and trust-region state. The corpus supplies only representation learning: no corpus molecule is retrieved, ranked, or treated as a fixed candidate, and every oracle proposal is a newly decoded de novo molecule selected to raise terminal Top-1.

method_tags.acquisition_mechanism: Gaussian-process posterior Thompson selection over a freshly generated trust-region candidate pool
method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline corpus-only SeqFlow training plus a task-local latent Gaussian process fit only to oracle-evaluated molecule-score pairs
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: evaluated-anchor trust-region perturbation of latent token blocks followed by inverse-flow de novo decoding
method_tags.representation: SELFIES token sequences mapped to an exactly reconstructible continuous latent space by an autoregressive normalizing flow

random-unit-sphere token codebook construction with radius 1.0 and the fixed numeric constant 0x5E0F10 within each seed-specific vocabulary shape
task-agnostic four-epoch autoregressive affine SeqFlow likelihood training with inherited dequantization, active/padded weighting, AdamW optimization, and seeded minibatch ordering
symmetric 0.85*tanh autoregressive affine scale map with collision-safe _flow_params dispatch
inference-only deterministic zero-dequantization heldout active-block latent-NLL and raw float32 codebook-digest diagnostic
exact zero-perturbation token and canonical round-trip admission on heldout and objective-session molecules
unchanged two-file SeqFlow state and configuration artifact contract with fixed 98-by-12 online latent shape

applicability_conditions: The ordered vocabulary must remain stable across preparation seeds so a shared codebook row retains the same token identity; the inherited robust SELFIES alphabet and deterministic token ordering provide that condition in the Parent.

Seed-dependent random codebook geometry must contribute materially to representation variability. The mechanism need not reduce heldout-NLL or terminal-score dispersion if corpus sampling, conditioner initialization, online proposal randomness, or objective ruggedness dominates instead.

The shared spherical codebook must retain distinct finite token centers and preserve exact zero-perturbation token and canonical reconstruction on every heldout and objective-session molecule; reduced variability cannot replace the frozen exactness gate.
The lineage-level codebook constant is task agnostic and used only during corpus-only preparation; it receives no task identity, oracle score, corpus retrieval request, or online feedback.

This is distinct from rejected node n-ca3bd2057287 because training remains exactly four epochs with no heldout checkpoint selection, and from rejected node n-035412fc1948 because the symmetric 0.85*tanh affine scale map is unchanged. It does not revisit Knowledge-only cluster c-5d13b8b06f because online eligible-block probabilities remain uniform.

Vocabulary construction, corpus sampling, preparation seed use outside codebook construction, model dimensions and state keys, dequantization, optimizer, loss weighting, exact inverse service, two-file artifact contract, and every surrogate, trust-region, filtering, acquisition, feedback, fallback, and protocol behavior remain unchanged.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not produce its registered effect if independently prepared Candidate artifacts do not contain byte-identical codebook tensors, if the three-seed standard deviation of deterministic heldout active-block latent NLL does not decrease relative to the Parent epoch-4 values established by n-ca3bd2057287, or if seed 0 no longer reproduces its Parent NLL despite using the same codebook constant and unchanged training path. Any artifact load failure or heldout or objective-session token or canonical round-trip rate below 1.0 also falsifies the usable representation mechanism. If the shared digest, reduced NLL dispersion, and exactness checks pass but terminal score does not improve, the mechanism activated without objective utility rather than failing to run.
research_intent.implementation_change: Change only preparation-time codebook construction so AutoregressiveSeqFlow uses the fixed lineage constant 0x5E0F10 directly instead of XORing it with the supplied preparation seed; all other uses of the supplied seed remain inherited. Add an inference-only post-training heldout diagnostic that reports active-block latent NLL and the codebook tensor digest without selecting or altering the artifact. Keep the random-unit-sphere construction, codebook radius, four-epoch training, symmetric affine map, state/configuration interfaces, exact round-trip gates, and all online behavior unchanged.
research_intent.mechanism: Use one seed-invariant deterministic spherical token codebook for every independently prepared SeqFlow artifact, removing preparation-seed-specific token-center geometry so the learned representations share a common discrete neighborhood basis and can vary only through the inherited corpus and optimizer stochasticity.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-5e9392f126c0 loads and reconstructs exactly on all three seeds, but each preparation assigns a different random spherical codebook and its macro score ranges from 0.441893056926007 to 0.531102062096459 (standard deviation 0.04100326143244739), with drd2_docking standard deviation 0.14883935107026078. Node n-b8f59c580ca4 additionally shows that the resulting local representation is inefficient, with 335,178 of 365,802 Parent seed-0 latent proposals decoding to the unchanged anchor. Representation siblings isolate why another likelihood or affine intervention is not the next test: n-ca3bd2057287 lowered heldout latent NLL on every seed yet lost 0.07334922775267033 paired macro score, while n-035412fc1948 changed contraction and lost 0.020383727828440668 on average. The limiting behavior addressed here is therefore the Parent's uncontrolled per-seed codebook neighborhood basis, not exactness, training duration, or affine displacement scaling.

applicability_conditions: The low-level implementation claim is supported: under each artifact's own vocabulary shape, the spherical codebook is generated with the same task-agnostic constant 0x5E0F10, while the supplied preparation seed continues to govern the inherited corpus and optimizer stochasticity.

The intended cross-seed shared-codebook claim is not applicable to these replicas because vocabulary size and therefore tensor shape vary across seeds. A future test requires one identical ordered vocabulary before codebook construction, not merely one identical random seed.

The deterministic heldout diagnostic applies to the observed 512-molecule seed-specific splits, 24,266, 24,425, and 24,267 active blocks, zero dequantization, inclusion of the standard-normal constant, exclusion of padded positions, and the published epoch-four state.

Usable exact representation is supported for all three observed artifacts: heldout gates are exactly 512/512 in token and canonical space, and every one of the 15 downstream sessions loads its artifact and preserves exact reconstruction for all admitted observations.

The implementation remains corpus-only and preparation-local: the constant and diagnostic receive no task identity, oracle score, retrieval request, or online feedback, and the two-file schema and 98-by-12 online representation interface remain unchanged.

The evidence refutes reduced heldout-NLL dispersion for the implemented seed-only intervention. It does not settle whether a fully shared vocabulary-and-codebook construction would reduce dispersion or improve terminal objective utility.

observable_measurements.parent_value: Parent n-5e9392f126c0 trains for four epochs and publishes the terminal state, but it has no post-training heldout-NLL or raw-codebook-digest diagnostic. The preregistered behaviorally identical Parent epoch-four values established by n-ca3bd2057287 are therefore the comparison baseline: 0.2078374278435583 for seed 0, 0.2154588091562568 for seed 1, and 0.21565150255391471 for seed 2. Their arithmetic mean is 0.21298257985124328 and their three-seed population standard deviation is 0.003639022265482285. Parent source derives its codebook seed as preparation seed XOR 0x5E0F10, yielding different numeric seeds across preparations, while retaining the same seed-dependent corpus, vocabulary, optimizer, and four-epoch path. Parent heldout token and canonical roundtrip rates are 1.0 on all three seeds, and its 15 objective sessions likewise retain exact admitted-example reconstruction, so exactness is an unchanged supporting baseline rather than evidence for the Candidate's claimed shared geometry.
observable_measurements.value: All three preparations executed the new fixed numeric codebook seed and emitted the registered inference-only post-epoch-four diagnostic, but they did not produce one seed-invariant codebook tensor and the registered dispersion decrease did not occur. Seed 0 used 24,266 active BOS/SELFIES/EOS blocks, recorded NLL 0.2078374278435583, vocabulary size 94, codebook_seed 6164240, and raw float32 codebook digest 060824d2b85105fbb5ff5dbcc0a451d64d6ffb3ea969f5363668bc7c31b0fdca. Seed 1 used 24,425 active blocks, recorded NLL 0.21520257402466897, vocabulary size 96, the same numeric codebook seed 6164240, and digest 737f1cbec90dd42056b725f2c7afc3f36700fb449762937c4ef3055a4e087005. Seed 2 used 24,267 active blocks, recorded NLL 0.20715048940258268, vocabulary size 92, the same numeric codebook seed 6164240, and digest 3e9be224881573358bcce8670d486e7d4fe8d8cba22e591b2afe68d4b6707f11. Thus there are three distinct digests rather than the required single digest. The Candidate arithmetic mean NLL is 0.21006349709026997 and its three-seed population standard deviation is 0.0036446815049398814, which is 0.000005659239457596419 above the registered Parent standard deviation 0.003639022265482285, so the observable increased rather than decreased. The per-seed Candidate-minus-Parent NLL changes are 0.0, -0.0002562351315878175, and -0.008501013151332032: seed 0 reproduces its Parent value exactly, but the heterogeneous decreases on seeds 1 and 2 do not reduce cross-seed dispersion. The mandatory usability gate did pass. Each preparation reconstructed 512/512 heldout examples exactly in token and canonical space, totaling 1,536/1,536 at both levels. Across all 15 objective sessions, all 450 cumulative exact-roundtrip records report token_rate 1.0, canonical_rate 1.0, and zero representation failures; every session ends at 300/300 exact token and canonical reconstructions, totaling 4,500/4,500 final cumulative admitted observations at both levels. All three two-file artifacts loaded, all 15 tasks completed 300 calls, and all three summaries report status ok. These exactness successes do not rescue the failed digest and dispersion requirements in the preregistered observable.

possible_failure_causes: The inherited preparation-seed-dependent reservoir and vocabulary construction produced vocabularies of 94, 96, and 92 tokens. deterministic_codebook draws a vocabulary_size-by-12 tensor, so supplying the same RNG seed cannot yield byte-identical tensors when their first dimensions differ. This directly violates the registered stable-vocabulary applicability condition.

Different vocabulary membership can also shift the sorted index of a shared lexical token. Consequently, even common prefixes of the fixed-seed random draws are not guaranteed to preserve the same token-to-row identity across artifacts; fixing only the random generator seed does not establish a shared discrete neighborhood basis.

The residual seed-dependent corpus split, vocabulary, conditioner initialization, minibatch order, dequantization noise, and optimization path remain active. The fixed numeric codebook seed changed seeds 1 and 2 unevenly while leaving seed 0 unchanged, and the resulting NLL dispersion increased slightly rather than decreasing, consistent with those retained sources dominating or interacting with codebook geometry.

The arithmetic mean NLL decreased because seed 2 moved substantially, but the preregistered mediator was lower cross-seed standard deviation plus a shared digest, not lower mean NLL. The heterogeneous per-seed movement therefore cannot be treated as activation of the intended variability-reduction mechanism.

The evidence covers only this corpus procedure, three preparation seeds, the observed seed-specific vocabularies, four epochs, and one numerical backend. It does not establish what a genuinely fixed vocabulary and fixed codebook tensor would do to representation or score variability.
